units.source_text: 虽然事隔十七年，源氏公子丝毫也不曾忘记那个百看不厌的夕颜。

en.t: Although seventeen years had passed, Prince Genji had never for a moment forgotten Yugao, whose beauty he could never tire of seeing.

units.source_text: 他阅尽了袅娜娉婷的种种女子，可是想起了这个夕颜，总觉得可恋可惜，

en.t: He had known all kinds of graceful and charming women, yet whenever he thought of this Yugao, he always felt both longing and regret,

units.source_text: 但愿她还活在人间才好。

en.t: and wished that she were still alive in this world.

units.source_text: 夕颜的侍女右近，虽然不是十分出色的女子，

en.t: Yugao's attendant Ukon was not an especially remarkable woman,

units.source_text: 但他把她看作夕颜的遗爱，一向优待她，

en.t: but he regarded her as a keepsake of Yugao and had always treated her with favor,

units.source_text: 叫她和老侍女们一起在邸内供职。

en.t: letting her serve in his residence together with the older gentlewomen.

units.source_text: 他流寓须磨之时，将所有侍女移交紫姬，

en.t: When he was living in exile at Suma, he entrusted all his serving women to Lady Murasaki,

units.source_text: 右近便也改在西殿供职了。

en.t: and Ukon too came to serve in the western wing.

units.source_text: 紫姬觉得这个人品性善良，行为恭谨，因而很看重她。

en.t: Lady Murasaki found her good-natured and modest in conduct, and therefore valued her highly.

units.source_text: 但右近心中在想：“我家小姐如果在世，公子对她的宠爱不会亚于明石夫人吧。

en.t: But Ukon thought to herself, "If my lady were still alive, the prince's affection for her would surely be no less than for the Lady of Akashi.

units.source_text: 爱情并不甚深的女子，公子尚且不忍遗弃，都相当照拂，永远关心，

en.t: Even women for whom his love was not especially deep, the prince still could not bear to abandon; he looked after them properly and remained concerned for them always,

units.source_text: 何况我家小姐。

en.t: so how much more would he have cared for my lady.

units.source_text: 即使不能与高贵的紫夫人同列，至少有份加入六条院诸人之中。”

en.t: Even if she could not have stood beside the noble Lady Murasaki, she would at least have had a place among the women of Rokujo-in."

units.source_text: 想起了便悲伤不已。

en.t: Whenever she thought of this, her grief was endless.

units.source_text: 加之夕颜所生女孩玉鬘，寄养在西京夕颜的乳母家里，现在不通消息。

en.t: Moreover, Yugao's daughter Tamakazura had been fostered in the western capital at the home of Yugao's wet nurse, and now there was no news of her.

units.source_text: 这是因为右近一向不敢把夕颜暴死之事公布于众，

en.t: This was because Ukon had never dared to make public the matter of Yugao's sudden death,

units.source_text: 加之源氏公子曾经叮嘱她不可泄露他的姓名，

en.t: and because Prince Genji had once warned her not to reveal his name,

units.source_text: 因而有所顾忌，不便赴西京探访。

en.t: so she had reservations and found it difficult to go to the western capital to inquire after the child.

units.source_text: 在这期间，乳母的丈夫升任了太宰少弍，赴筑紫履任，乳母随夫迁居任地，

en.t: In the meantime, the wet nurse's husband was promoted to junior assistant governor of Dazaifu and went to take up his post in Tsukushi, and the wet nurse moved with him to his place of appointment,

units.source_text: 其时玉鬘年方四岁。

en.t: when Tamakazura was only four years old.
